audience.text: Java developers building server-side or desktop applications that require PDF document generation, manipulation, and conversion without third-party runtime dependencies.

capabilities.text: Create new documents, add pages, and modify content using Document, Page, and Paragraphs APIs.
capabilities.title: Create and edit PDF documents

capabilities.text: Create and manipulate AcroForm fields including text boxes, checkboxes, radio buttons, and combo boxes.
capabilities.title: Work with interactive forms

capabilities.text: Add widget annotations, set their border and background colors, and configure border styles.
capabilities.title: Add and manage annotations

capabilities.text: Render PDF pages to raster formats including BMP, GIF, JPEG, PNG, and multi-page TIFF.
capabilities.title: Render pages to images

capabilities.text: Extract plain text from pages using TextAbsorber and images using PdfExtractor.
capabilities.title: Extract text and images

capabilities.text: Apply AES or RC4 encryption with user and owner passwords, and sign documents with PKCS#7 signatures.
capabilities.title: Encrypt and sign documents

capabilities.text: Reduce file size through stream recompression, duplicate linking, and resource subsetting.
capabilities.title: Optimize document size

capabilities.text: Convert PDF to HTML, XML, DOCX, XLSX, Markdown, or raster formats and import from supported sources.
capabilities.title: Convert documents

limitations.text: No OCR support; use a dedicated OCR library for text recognition in scanned images.
Concurrency is not supported for a single Document instance; use one instance per thread.
PdfFileSecurity.setAllowExceptions throws UnsupportedOperationException for legacy toolkit paths.
Text replacement with non-Latin scripts may differ from reference renderers in complex bidi cases.
Resource optimization has limited advanced strategies like image downsampling and font merging.
Tagged PDF structure is readable and constructible but not fully covered for well-formed trees.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic PDF creation, editing, and conversion using a pure Java API with no external runtime dependencies.
Supports interactive forms, annotations, and document security features including encryption and digital signatures.
Provides page-level operations such as splitting, merging, inserting, extracting, and reordering pages via PdfFileEditor.
Offers rendering to raster images (BMP, GIF, JPEG, PNG, TIFF) and text extraction per page.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for Java is a free, open-source, pure-Java library for creating, reading, and modifying PDF documents compliant with ISO 32000-1:2008.

workflows.name: Build and test
workflows.text: Build the project with `mvn package` and run tests with `mvn -B clean test` using JUnit 5.

workflows.name: Install from Maven Central
workflows.text: Install the library using Maven with `mvn dependency:get -Dartifact=org.aspose:aspose-pdf-foss:26.11.0`.

workflows.name: Create and save a PDF
workflows.text: Create a new document, add a page, insert a text fragment, and save to output.pdf using the Document API.

workflows.name: Add form fields to a cell
workflows.text: Create a table cell, add text and radio button option fields, and preserve insertion order in the cell's paragraphs.

workflows.name: Configure widget annotation appearance
workflows.text: Create a widget annotation, set its border color and background color, then read back the color values.

workflows.name: Set annotation border style
workflows.text: Create a radio button option field, construct a Border object, set its style to dashed, and verify round-trip.
